intro: The platinum takes about 200 hours in a single playthrough. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free roam continues after the story and everything except one Chapter 1 meditation stays available, so the plan below is safe: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. Figures and warnings on this page come from PowerPyx, GTABase, KeenGamer and Push Square (see the source list at the bottom).

stages.goal: Finish the story, protect the one missable trophy, and bank progress toward the grind trophies.
notes: Save manually at the start of every chapter. There is no mission replay, so a manual save is your only way back.

In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth: find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she talks about meditating, and accept. This is the one potentially missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude).

Play the story with both characters as the game asks: Andy's questline is Lucia-only, Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only, and the last meditation spot needs both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

Take optional missions and character quests as they appear. Many disappear after a while, but the trophy-related quest givers (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) all return later and stay available in free roam.
Scan vehicles and study animals as you go: progress toward Whip It Good and the hunting trophies already counts during the story.
Do not use cheats: they disable trophies and saving.
Steer clear of the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and cannot be undone.
stages.title: Step 1 — Story and the one missable trophy
stages.trophies: 12 story trophies (opening mission, Chapters 1-5, 6 named missions, final mission) + the contact questlines as they appear

stages.goal: Open the 100% checklist and grind it down. This is the longest part of the hunt and it unlocks A Long Road.
notes: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist only becomes viewable once the story is done, but story progress already counts.

The checklist includes: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 cocaine flamingos, 300 stunts and 70 of the 80 challenges (KeenGamer).
Work region by region: clear one area's robberies, collectibles and stunts before moving on, so nothing is left half-done.
Robberies feed several trophies at once: bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal), gang operations (Pest Control), marked bills (Dime on the Dollar).
Keep meditating at every marked spot you pass: 18 in total for Positive Mental Attitude.
stages.title: Step 2 — The 100% completion checklist
stages.trophies: A Long Road (gold), Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, Maximum Withdrawal, Pest Control, Dime on the Dollar, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, One Last Thing, Whip It Good, The Goodtime State

stages.goal: Finish whatever the checklist did not cover, then check the tracker for the last few trophies.
notes: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which strands count, so do more than 8 if you can.
Finish the contact questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and Bret's hunting if any are left.
Try each of the 9 activity types once for Master of None, if you have not already: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Buy all 8 garage properties (Little Boxes) once the money is there, and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (On the Spot).
Spend $100,000 across shops (Treat Yo Self) — it should be close by now.
Check the tracker below: anything still unchecked is a single-session trophy (a race win, a shop robbery, a cocktail on Ocean Beach).
stages.title: Step 3 — Strangers, contacts and cleanup
stages.trophies: Strangers & Freaks, Road to Rehabilitation, This Was No Boat Accident, The Lone Rider, Supply & Demand, Spin On This!, Fair Game, Master of None, Little Boxes, On the Spot, Treat Yo Self + the remaining misc trophies

missable.note: Only one trophy is flagged as potentially missable, by PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer alike. Everything else can be finished in free roam after the story, because every trophy-related quest giver returns and the 100% checklist stays open.
missable.trophy: Positive Mental Attitude — meditate at every spot across Leonida. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia (after Down to Earth, at Jason's house in the morning) can only be done in Chapter 1, and it is unclear whether it counts toward the 18 spots. Do it before leaving Chapter 1.
